name: Veeva Systems
description: Veeva sells cloud software and data to the pharmaceutical and biotech industry: CRM for drug sales teams, Vault applications that run clinical trials, regulatory filings, safety and quality documents, and data products. About 84% of revenue is annual subscriptions and 16% is professional services and other, so it behaves like a software company even though it only serves the life-sciences industry. It has 1,552 customers, and the top 10 are 28% of revenue; about 40% of revenue is from outside North America. Operating income was $916 million on $3,195 million of revenue in FY2026, a 28.7% margin. It reports a single segment.

businessLines.name: R&D and Quality Solutions (Veeva Development Cloud and Quality Cloud)
businessLines.how: Annual subscriptions (priced per application and user or by usage tier) to Vault software for clinical trials, regulatory, safety and quality/manufacturing documents, mostly sold to drugmakers and biotechs; implemented with paid professional services.

businessLines.name: Commercial Solutions (Veeva Commercial Cloud and Veeva Data Cloud)
businessLines.how: Annual subscriptions to sales and marketing CRM (moving from the legacy CRM to Vault CRM) for drugmakers, plus licensed data and analytics products (Veeva Data Cloud, Crossix) sold by subscription.

brands.name: Veeva Vault CRM, Clinical Platform, Development Cloud, Quality Cloud, Commercial Cloud, Data Cloud
brands.note: Product families; only the Commercial (45%) versus R&D and Quality (55%) revenue split is disclosed.

brands.name: Veeva Crossix (data and analytics)
brands.note: Part of Veeva Data Cloud / Commercial Solutions; revenue not broken out.
